newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM calls for rapid financial reform -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM calls for rapid financial reform -- MOF.

text.p: Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto on Monday called for the rapid reform of Japan's financial markets to make them as attractive as those of New York and London, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said.

After a meeting with the prime minister, Mitsuzuka told reporters: "This is going to be Tokyo's 'big bang,'" referring to Britain's financial reforms in 1986 that removed barriers between various financial institutions.
Justice Minister Isao Matsuura, who also attended the meeting, said his ministry would extend its full cooperation in carrying out the reforms.
